rows.text: The party's post of 10 April 2022 lists the Central Committee elected at the 23rd Congress and the 17-member Polit Bureau elected at its first meeting, and says 'The Central Committee also re-elected Sitaram Yechury as the General Secretary'; it adds that the new Central Control Commission 'met today'.
